levels.name: Technical Compliance
levels.outcome: Projects use required package-native/dashboard-kit contracts and no longer hide old implementation debt.

levels.name: Visual Quality Migration
levels.outcome: Dashboards look and behave like polished products, not just compliant pages.

levels.name: Product-Building OS
levels.outcome: Ideas become product briefs, component maps, workflows, tests, and proof before being called done.

levels.name: Self-Improving Product OS
levels.outcome: Usage, screenshots, failures, and human preference continuously improve products and standards.

levels.name: Company Intelligence Layer
levels.outcome: TLC has memory, decision intelligence, OKR/KPI linkage, risk, finance, and strategy execution visibility.

levels.name: Compound Learning Enterprise
levels.outcome: The company learns, allocates resources, governs humans/agents, and compounds IP over time.

workstreams.name: Fleet project inventory
workstreams.acceptance: Every active project has route inventory, target tier, proof route, production URL, and owner.

workstreams.name: Technical implementation audit
workstreams.acceptance: Strict rendered-implementation report shows 10/10 fully decomposed, 0 findings, 0 false-native risk.

workstreams.name: No local override policy
workstreams.acceptance: Local visual primitive overrides require reason, expiration, proof, and promotion path.

workstreams.name: Central dashboard certification gate
workstreams.acceptance: dashboard:certify generates fleet certification, repair packets, attempt ledger, and blocks fleet:ship-check before deployment when false-native or shell/rendered implementation debt exists.

workstreams.name: Self-healing repair packet protocol
workstreams.acceptance: Certification creates per-project repair packets and rerun commands; next maturity is automated safe repair and retry loops.

workstreams.name: Certification repair supervisor
workstreams.acceptance: dashboard:certify:repair classifies failures, creates repair playbooks, separates safe from assisted repairs, and produces a prioritized execution order.

workstreams.name: Repair supervisor validation
workstreams.acceptance: Repair playbooks and supervisor outputs validate with dashboard:certify:repair:validate:strict.

workstreams.name: Automated repair execution
workstreams.acceptance: dashboard:certify:repair:execute records safe execution state, queues assisted migrations, and is wired into ship check before the final strict certification gate.

workstreams.name: Visual tier model
workstreams.acceptance: Add V0 through V4 visual maturity tiers alongside technical/product tiers.

workstreams.name: Visual acceptance rubric
workstreams.acceptance: Rubric scores sidebar, hierarchy, spacing, cards, typography, tables, charts, forms, drawers, responsive states, and interaction polish.

workstreams.name: Planner/calendar components
workstreams.acceptance: Month calendar, week/day drawer, multi-select, planner detail, and export states exist for Meal Assistant and future planners.

workstreams.name: Intent-to-product protocol
workstreams.acceptance: User intent becomes product goal, workflows, data model, routes, components, proof states, and tests.

workstreams.name: Company memory model
workstreams.acceptance: Decisions, experiments, launches, failures, wins, OKRs, KPIs, risks, assets, docs, and postmortems are queryable.

workstreams.name: Agent role registry
workstreams.acceptance: Agent roles, permissions, work queues, escalation rules, audit logs, and performance history exist.

workstreams.name: Outcome attribution
workstreams.acceptance: Work connects to results across posts, traffic, OKRs, experiments, strategies, returns, dashboards, and actions.

workstreams.name: Institutional knowledge engine
workstreams.acceptance: Beliefs, evidence, contradictions, staleness, and decision impact are tracked.

workstreams.name: Visual review queue schema
workstreams.acceptance: dashboard-visual-review-queue.json/md exist and are validated by the UI-quality system gate.

workstreams.name: Screenshot approval and rejection memory schema
workstreams.acceptance: dashboard-design-preference-memory.json/md exist and preserve approved/rejected patterns.

workstreams.name: Meal Assistant visual migration packet
workstreams.acceptance: Meal Assistant V3 visual migration packet exists with target pages, components, workflow proof, visual proof, and acceptance criteria.

workstreams.name: Dashboard visual review UI
workstreams.acceptance: Dashboard Kit Gallery exposes visual tiers, queued reviews, preference memory, rubric criteria, and the first Meal Assistant migration packet.

nextBuildPacket: Clear dashboard-certification repair packets project by project, starting with the highest operational pain or smallest repair surface.
Automate safe repair/retry loops for known certification failure classes.
Add screenshot-aware visual regression comparison for approved baselines.
Repeat the visual-quality migration loop for Media Engine, Kashi VC, Media Business Ops, Investing System, TLC OS, Hermes OS, Business Mapper, and Rinseables.

items: Wired certification strict gate into fleet ship check.
Added dashboard certification repair execution ledger.
Tightened visual-selector production-risk detection to ignore guarded local-only dev selectors.
Scoped local visual debt certification to UI surfaces instead of server/data surfaces.
Updated maturity plan baseline to show certification-blocked false-native fleet state.

latestCertificationBaseline.note: The prior rendered-implementation audit remains a source scan only. Strict certification is now the dashboard promotion authority.
